answer: Simultaneous liveness audits: at random moments the network fires a gale of fresh, unpredictable tasks at every agent at once, each needing real model inference within seconds. An operator running 500 sybils must provision compute for all 500 concurrently instead of time-sharing one backend; identities that time out or return near-identical outputs are flagged as hollow shells and forfeit their bonded deposit. Reaching the summit of reputation thus costs compute and collateral per identity, so faking many never beats honestly running one.
